$comment: Profiles verified against live provider metadata. `retention` must come from retention.yml; a model missing there cannot enter this list. The default is a fleet, because a fleet is the point: ten jobs, ten models, one session.

profiles.title: Ten jobs, zero-retention models only
profiles.note: The default. Every lane resolves to a provider with a zero-retention policy, at the cost of four jobs not getting the model built for them.

profiles.title: Ten jobs, every free model, one of them may train
profiles.note: Every lane gets the model built for it. Five of the ten providers may use the data to improve the model, so the whole profile is may-train.

profiles.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash Free
profiles.note: 512k output tokens, the widest of any free route. The only one that takes video.

profiles.title: Beam Free
profiles.note: Text only, freshest knowledge on the tier, fastest measured route. Keeps prompts for 30 days, so it is not zero-retention.

profiles.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Free
profiles.note: Reasoning plus agentic coding plus structured output, on a zero-retention provider.

profiles.title: GLM 5.3 Flash Free
profiles.note: The only free model with structured output and a zero-retention policy. Slowest route on the tier at 16-27s.

profiles.title: LongCat 2.5 Preview Free
profiles.note: 1M context with image input and a zero-retention provider. A preview endpoint: it can be withdrawn without a rename.

profiles.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL Free
profiles.note: The only free model publishing a `none` effort level, so it is the reasoning-off sweep lane. Hangs on an image attachment.

profiles.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free
profiles.note: The largest open MoE on the tier at 550B-A55B. No selectable effort. NVIDIA trial terms: sessions are logged.

profiles.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free
profiles.note: Its output cap equals its whole context, so it emits files larger than 128k tokens. One measured call took 114s.

profiles.title: MiMo V2.6 Flash Free
profiles.note: Reads images in 8s. Publishes audio input too, but OpenCode will not read a binary file, so that path is unreachable today.

profiles.title: Big Pickle
profiles.note: Stealth model, no public identity, no effort levels, no image input. The provider may train on it during its free period.
